# ToolApproval

> Inline approve or deny card for an agent action, with risk, a preview of what will run, and keyboard shortcuts.

This file matches the installed `tool-approval` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/tool-approval.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/tool-approval.md`.

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Send } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { ToolApprovalState } from "@/components/control-ui/tool-approval";
import {
  ToolApproval,
  ToolApprovalApprove,
  ToolApprovalBody,
  ToolApprovalDeny,
  ToolApprovalDescription,
  ToolApprovalField,
  ToolApprovalFooter,
  ToolApprovalHeader,
  ToolApprovalIcon,
  ToolApprovalPreview,
  ToolApprovalRisk,
  ToolApprovalStatus,
  ToolApprovalTitle,
} from "@/components/control-ui/tool-approval";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";

export function ToolApprovalExample() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ToolApprovalState>("pending");

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-md gap-3">
      <ToolApproval state={state} risk="medium" onApprove={() => setState("approved")} onDeny={() => setState("denied")}>
        <ToolApprovalBody>
          <ToolApprovalHeader>
            <ToolApprovalIcon>
              <Send />
            </ToolApprovalIcon>
            <ToolApprovalTitle>Post to #revenue</ToolApprovalTitle>
            <ToolApprovalRisk />
            <ToolApprovalStatus />
          </ToolApprovalHeader>
          <ToolApprovalDescription>The agent wants to share this week's churn summary with the finance channel.</ToolApprovalDescription>
          <ToolApprovalPreview>
            <ToolApprovalField label="Tool">slack.post</ToolApprovalField>
            <ToolApprovalField label="Channel">#revenue</ToolApprovalField>
            <ToolApprovalField label="Message">
              Churn rose 0.4 pt to 3.1% last week, driven by monthly Starter plans in EMEA.
            </ToolApprovalField>
          </ToolApprovalPreview>
        </ToolApprovalBody>
        <ToolApprovalFooter>
          <ToolApprovalDeny />
          <ToolApprovalApprove />
        </ToolApprovalFooter>
      </ToolApproval>
      <Button
        size="xs"
        variant="quiet"
        className="justify-self-center"
        onClick={() => setState(state === "pending" ? "expired" : "pending")}
      >
        {state === "pending" ? "Let the request time out" : "Reset"}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
